title: Branch-Solve-Merge Improves Large Language Model Evaluation and Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the fraction of samples where the evaluator model's preference judgment changes based solely on the encoding order of the responses (swapping the order of responses).
Calculating the fraction of samples where the evaluator model incorrectly prefers a longer response over a shorter one, contrary to human preference.

Evaluating whether an LLM judge correlates better with human preferences when evaluating its own generated responses, measured by comparing human agreement on a subset of samples where one response is generated by the evaluator model itself.
